propositions: A new hard-fail CI gate can break branches created before the gate was added, causing regressions in in-flight branches without detecting the incompatibility.

The code-review gate currently has no criterion to verify whether a pipeline/gate-configuration change introduces hard-fail steps or required gates with no grandfather guard for pre-existing branches.
Project code-review criteria are dispatched unconditionally without filtering against changed-file globs, preventing applies_to declarations from gating criterion activation.

The applies_to mechanism must be declarative via glob patterns for multiple CI systems (.github/workflows, Jenkinsfile, .gitlab-ci.yml, etc.) rather than hard-coded to vendor-specific paths to maintain portability.
The glob set must be project-overridable through a config key (code_review.ci_config_globs) so unusual pipelines are declared rather than enumerated in shipped code.
